subject: Coffee & Tea
title: Third-Wave Coffee Shops
description: A quick win: understand Third-Wave Coffee Shops.

hook.text: Third-wave coffee shops treat coffee like wine—single-origin, transparently sourced, and carefully prepared.

buildup.text: First wave was mass consumption (Folgers). Second wave was café culture (Starbucks). Third wave is craft quality.

discovery.text: Third-wave shops pay farmers 2–5x the commodity price and display the farm name on every bag.

twist.text: Critics call it elitist—a $7 pour-over excludes most consumers. Access to quality shouldn't require wealth.

climax.text: Despite criticism, third-wave economics prove that consumers will pay more when quality and story are visible.

punchline.text: Know the farmer, taste the difference, pay the real price.

quiz.question: What defines 'third-wave' coffee?
options: Treating coffee like wine—single-origin, transparent, craft-focused
